desc_about: Sport Power is the first personal training company in Palestine, with branches in Bethlehem, Beit Sahour and Amman and a team of coaches and a nutritionist.
about_title: The first personal training company in Palestine
about_p1: Sport Power started in Bethlehem with a simple idea: personal training should be a system, not a passing session. A coach who knows you, a plan built on your measurements, a nutritionist who follows your eating, and weekly follow-up that keeps you on track.
about_p2: Today we work from three branches in Palestine and Jordan, and we share what we learned building the company with coaches and academy owners through our courses.
value1_p: We start from the real number and track it monthly. Results are not built on impressions.
value2_p: A program you can keep for a year beats a perfect one you drop after two weeks.
value3_p: Everything we do is recorded in our internal system: your sessions, measurements and plan. Nothing is lost when a coach changes.
contact_lead: We answer WhatsApp and phone during working hours, and website requests within 24 hours.
privacy_1_t: What we collect on the website
privacy_1_p: When you fill in the join or course form we store your name and mobile number, and optionally your email, where you live and your message. We do not collect health data through the website; measurements and health notes are recorded later in the member system, with your consent, when you sign up.
privacy_2_p: Only to contact you about your request: scheduling your starting assessment or answering your course enquiry. We do not send marketing messages without your permission, and we never sell or share your data with third parties.
privacy_3_p: In Sport Power's internal system on a database with encrypted connections, accessible only to management and reception through accounts protected by two-factor authentication.
privacy_4_p: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data at any time by writing to the email or WhatsApp listed on the contact page.
privacy_5_p: The website uses no advertising trackers. We only store your dark-mode and language preference in your browser.

faq_title: Everything you want to know before you start
faq1_a: Fill in the join form or message us on WhatsApp. Our reception team contacts you within 24 hours to schedule a free starting assessment, then you choose your package, sign your contract online and start.
faq2_q: Do I need previous experience or a certain fitness level?
faq2_a: No. The program is built on your own assessment: your current condition, your goal and your lifestyle. We start from where you are, whether it is your first time training or you are an athlete.
faq3_a: Every package has a number of sessions and a validity period. A session is deducted when delivered, and a session cancelled less than 4 hours before its time is counted.
faq4_a: Yes, once per subscription for up to two weeks, by prior request at reception.
faq5_q: What is InBody and why do we measure it?
faq5_a: A device that measures body composition: fat percentage, muscle mass and water. We measure you at the start and then monthly, so your program and meal plan are built on real numbers, not the scale alone.
faq6_q: Where are the branches and in which currency are prices?
faq6_a: Three branches: Bethlehem and Beit Sahour in shekels, and Amman in Jordanian dinars. Prices on the packages page are shown in each branch's currency and are all-inclusive.
